tasks.short: Monitor bioinformatics databases and carry out necessary maintenance or repairs.

steps.what: Collect existing database performance counters and compare them with agreed operational thresholds
inputs: existing database telemetry produced by the database engine
actual thresholds maintained by database owner
outputs: performance observations with source timestamps and threshold comparisons

steps.what: Diagnose actual performance changes and determine whether maintenance or repair is warranted
inputs: performance observations with source timestamps and threshold comparisons
actual workload and incident context
outputs: human diagnosis and justified maintenance need

steps.what: Prepare the actual scoped maintenance, upgrade or repair plan and rollback procedure
inputs: human diagnosis and justified maintenance need
actual database dependencies and backup status
outputs: complete proposed operation plan and exact target

steps.what: Check the complete operation, rollback readiness, target and actual maintenance authority
inputs: complete proposed operation plan and exact target
actual maintenance authority and backup checks
outputs: checked exact operation version and target

steps.what: Execute the exact checked maintenance operation on the authorized database target
inputs: checked exact operation version and target
outputs: actual maintenance result and execution log

steps.what: Verify actual database behavior, data integrity and application performance after the operation
inputs: actual maintenance result and execution log
actual validation queries and application checks
outputs: post-operation validation findings

steps.what: Write actual maintenance and validation findings in the internal operations record
inputs: actual maintenance result and execution log
post-operation validation findings
outputs: authored internal maintenance record

tasks.design: Use read-only native telemetry queries to replace actual repeated counter collection and threshold comparisons. Keep diagnosis, operation planning, final readiness checking, actual maintenance execution, post-change validation and written records human; no dashboard signal executes a database change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing performance counters can be collected and compared repeatedly by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Scheduled read-only queries can expose those exact counters and thresholds.
tasks.still_hard: The cause of performance changes and safe operational response require contextual judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that a slow query reflects a valid new scientific workload rather than a fault.
tasks.altitude: Diagnose verified observations rather than collect counters manually.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: read-only database telemetry can collect counters and compare explicit thresholds without diagnosing causes or executing maintenance.

assumptions: Shares20/25/20/10/5/15/5 are provisional, not measured. s1 counts only actual manual counter collection/comparison, not engine runtime or monitoring already configured. Existing engine telemetry is its named producer.

This technician has actual maintenance authority in the modeled route; if another owner authorizes production work, map their existing review separately and exclude their labour. The execution gate protects a real database operation, not an ordinary author save. Record saves in s7 remain fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Which counters are manually collected and what actual change authority applies?
research_questions: Observe repeated monitoring separately from diagnosis and operation execution.

incremental.description: Maintain telemetry queries and threshold mappings when database versions change.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact operation plan, commands, target and rollback readiness; edits void the check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 repeated monitoring points less1 upkeep. Low: a newly upgraded engine has incompatible counters and most diagnosis needs ad hoc queries, leaving2 stable utilization-counter points removable, less1 upkeep. Diagnosis25, plan20, readiness10, execution5, validation15 and record5 remain.

tasks.short: Participate in actual scientific report or publication preparation.

steps.what: Verify actual molecular datasets, analysis versions and source permissions for the assigned contribution
inputs: actual versioned datasets and outputs produced by the research team
actual assigned contribution
outputs: verified source datasets, versions and limitations

steps.what: Determine the actual analysis explanation and scientific limitations with the research team
inputs: verified source datasets, versions and limitations
actual research question
outputs: technician-authored interpretation and contribution notes

steps.what: Assemble repeated report tables and figures from the verified analysis outputs
inputs: verified source datasets, versions and limitations
actual table and figure specifications chosen by research team
outputs: proposed tables and figures with source manifest

steps.what: Write the assigned scientific contribution from authored notes and verified tables
inputs: technician-authored interpretation and contribution notes
proposed tables and figures with source manifest
outputs: complete proposed scientific contribution

loop.purpose: Restate the technician's actual contribution notes as proposed scientific prose
loop.input: authored interpretation notes and verified table/figure manifest
loop.output: proposed contribution with exact source links and stated limitations
loop.check: Technician checks every quantitative statement, scientific implication, omission and limitation against sources and rejects new causal claims or invented references
loop.stop: Missing source/version support or two failed revisions returns prose drafting to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed report headings and deterministic tables come first; only variable explanatory prose needs a bounded loop

steps.what: Check the full contribution against actual analyses and save the internal manuscript contribution
inputs: complete proposed scientific contribution
verified source datasets, versions and limitations
technician-authored interpretation and contribution notes
outputs: checked internal scientific contribution

tasks.design: Generate specified repeated tables/figures deterministically and use a bounded draft only to restate the technician's actual interpretation notes. Keep source verification, scientific interpretation, substantive writing and complete source/meaning checks; this produces an internal contribution, not an automatic publication submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual output assembly and restating existing notes can repeat contribution work.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned data pipelines and constrained prose drafts separate exact output assembly from scientific meaning.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific validity and faithful uncertainty remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that an apparently clear summary overstates what the molecular analysis supports.
tasks.altitude: Check traceable scientific outputs instead of assembling repeated cells and panels.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic table/figure assembly and bounded prose restatement can support a scientific contribution after analysis specifications and source notes exist.

assumptions: Shares25/20/20/20/15 are provisional, not measured. s3 is actual manual repeated table/figure assembly, not existing statistical engine runtime; no credit if already pipelined. Actual interpretation notes are produced in s2, not freely inferred from numbers.

s4 removes4 restatement points only, retaining16 substantive writing/revision. Full contribution check15 and ordinary internal save remain retained and ungated. Research permissions must permit the approved prose tool; otherwise manual. No new biomedical interpretation, source citation, author approval ceremony or journal send is invented.
unknowns: Which actual contribution tables and figures are manually assembled?
research_questions: Reproduce one contribution and test numerical lineage plus scientific meaning.

incremental.description: Maintain output specifications and inspect prose/source failures when analyses change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 assembly plus4 prose-restatement points less1.5 upkeep. Low: inconsistent output metadata needs manual figure reconstruction, leaving5 compatible table points plus1 uncomplicated methods-restatement point removable, less1.5 upkeep. Source review25, interpretation20 and full check15 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain awareness of emerging computational methods and technologies.

steps.what: Search actual computational-method sources and inspect new releases relevant to current research
inputs: actual research interests
actual method publications and software release feeds maintained by their publishers
outputs: selected current method sources

steps.what: Read actual methods and evaluate assumptions, limitations and relevance to bioinformatics work
inputs: selected current method sources
outputs: human understanding of method capabilities and limitations

steps.what: Learn through actual seminars, demonstrations and exchanges with research colleagues
inputs: actual seminars, demonstrations and colleagues
human understanding of method capabilities and limitations
outputs: actual learning observations captured by technician

steps.what: Write actual assigned method-awareness notes and source references for later work
inputs: human understanding of method capabilities and limitations
actual learning observations captured by technician
outputs: authored internal method-awareness notes

tasks.design: Configure native saved searches and existing release-feed subscriptions to reduce repeated source navigation. Retain actual source reading, method evaluation, seminars, fresh learning capture and assigned notes; no generated source summary substitutes for understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated searches can revisit the same publisher and release pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches and release feeds can expose actual new source items.
tasks.still_hard: Method assumptions and relevance need technical learning.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that a promising method fails the current dataset's assumptions.
tasks.altitude: Spend more learning time on actual methods than finding release pages.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved searches and publisher release feeds reduce repeated retrieval without evaluating emerging computational methods.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual publication/reference search service and release-feed reader. Shares20/45/25/10 are provisional, not measured. Only2 repeated-navigation points disappear; selecting and reading candidate items remain.

s3 counts actual fresh learning capture, s4 only actual assigned notes/check/save. Remove/reweight notes if not owned. No invented digest, automatic upgrade or model-generated scientific evaluation is proposed.
unknowns: Which actual source pages are repeatedly checked rather than already subscribed?
research_questions: Observe retrieval separately from actual technical reading and experimentation.

incremental.description: Maintain actual method-search and release-feed filters.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 repeated-navigation points less0.4 upkeep. Low: a new method family needs unfamiliar sources and manual search, leaving0.6 familiar release-page navigation points removable, less0.4 upkeep. Reading45, exchanges25 and actual notes10 remain.

tasks.short: Test new or updated bioinformatics tools and provide actual developer feedback.

steps.what: Define actual test questions, representative datasets and acceptance checks for the tool update
inputs: actual software change and intended scientific use
actual representative test data approved for use
outputs: human-defined test plan, datasets and acceptance checks

steps.what: Prepare actual test cases using reusable native test fixtures where interfaces remain compatible
inputs: human-defined test plan, datasets and acceptance checks
existing test fixtures authored by technician
outputs: prepared test cases and expected fixed comparisons

steps.what: Repeat specified sandbox test commands and collect exact output differences against fixed expectations
inputs: prepared test cases and expected fixed comparisons
outputs: actual sandbox test outputs, logs and fixed comparison differences

steps.what: Interpret actual failures, scientific correctness and limitations of the test coverage
inputs: actual sandbox test outputs, logs and fixed comparison differences
human-defined test plan, datasets and acceptance checks
outputs: human-interpreted test findings and coverage limitations

steps.what: Write and check complete developer feedback against actual tests and reproducible failure evidence
inputs: human-interpreted test findings and coverage limitations
actual sandbox test outputs, logs and fixed comparison differences
actual developer destination
outputs: checked final developer feedback and destination

steps.what: Send exact checked test feedback and permitted evidence to the tool developers
inputs: checked final developer feedback and destination
outputs: sent developer feedback and evidence receipt

tasks.design: Reuse compatible native test fixtures and run explicitly specified sandbox tests deterministically, collecting fixed output differences. Retain test design, new-case authoring, scientific failure interpretation, actual feedback writing/checking and the separate developer send; no tool is upgraded into production.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated fixture setup and test-command execution can recur when validating updated tools.
tasks.enabler_now: Native test harnesses can reuse fixtures and repeat explicit commands with traceable logs.
tasks.still_hard: A passing numerical comparison does not establish scientific correctness or adequate coverage.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a scientifically wrong result despite a technically successful run.
tasks.altitude: Design and interpret tests rather than repeat sandbox commands.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic test harnesses reuse fixtures and repeat specified commands while scientific coverage and developer feedback require human interpretation.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual sandbox test runner. Shares20/25/20/20/14/1 are provisional, not measured. s2 removes5 actual repeated fixture-setup points; s3 only actual manual command/retrieval/comparison interactions, not software runtime or already automated tests.

The modeled developer recipient is outside the organization; for internal developers use write_internal and keep the same actual send boundary. s5 includes the existing author check of the actual final feedback, not an extra ordinary-save approval. Only permitted test evidence is sent; no raw genomic data disclosure is inferred.
unknowns: Which test interactions are actually repeated manually and which fixtures remain compatible?
research_questions: Compare actual sandbox logs with scientific acceptance expectations before reusing the runner.

incremental.description: Maintain fixtures and exact comparison mappings across tool versions.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final developer feedback, permitted evidence and developer destination; edits void the check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 fixture-setup plus20 repeated test-interaction points less1.5 upkeep. Low: a changed tool interface requires new cases and manual exploratory testing, leaving2 compatible fixture points plus4 unchanged fixed-test interaction points removable, less1.5 upkeep. Test design20, scientific interpretation20, feedback14 and send1 remain.

Design scientific acceptance checks beyond fixed output equality
